subject: Invoice delivery preference — portal primary with temporary email copies
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T08:22:11-08:00
Subject: Invoice delivery preferences and VAT evidence

Hi Marissa,

Quick question as we're getting set up for billing: our AP team needs to confirm how Redwood will deliver invoices and where VAT/evidence will be uploaded. Our preference is to enroll in your billing portal ultimately, but for the first few invoices we'd like a PDF copy sent to ap-team@acme-corp.com so our legacy system can ingest them while we finish the portal mapping.

Can you confirm:
- Whether the portal can be the primary delivery method and also send a PDF copy by email for a configurable window (we'd like 90 days)
- What VAT evidence files you accept and whether those can be attached via email or must be uploaded to the portal
- Any PO / remittance info you need from us to start (we have PO GF-1724)

Thanks — please loop anyone on your billing side who needs to set up SFTP or test payloads.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Accounts Payable Lead
Acme Corp
Attachments: PO_GF-1724.pdf (referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:10:03-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preferences and VAT evidence

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Looping in Connor (billing ops) for the technical side and Kimberly (CS) to confirm the account contact and enrollment cadence.

Short answers up front:
- Yes — we can make the Redwood Console (portal) the canonical delivery channel and send an automatic PDF copy to one or more email addresses for a limited window (we typically support a 30/60/90-day option). 90 days is fine.
- VAT evidence: portal upload is the most reliable (it ties to invoice metadata), but we can accept PDF attachments via email for temporary onboarding; we'll ingest them into our evidence store and attach to the invoice record.
- Required from you to start: PO number (you provided GF-1724 — perfect), AP contact email (please confirm ap-team@acme-corp.com), and remittance instructions if different from the PO.

Next steps I propose:
1) Connor will send a short onboarding checklist (SFTP credentials if you want push, sample XML schema if you want e-invoice) and a one-time test invoice file.
2) We enable portal enrollment and configure the email-copy window to 90 days.
3) Kimberly will confirm the billing contact in our system and set the billing notification preferences.

Attachments: invoice_sample.pdf (visual example of PDF copy)

If that works, Samantha — reply-all with a quick confirmation and I'll kick off the ops work.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com | +1 415-555-0198

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preferences and VAT evidence

Hi all — quick operations note from billing ops. We support three primary delivery modes: portal (console), SFTP push (XML or PDF), and email PDF fan-out. A few implementation details for your team to pick from:

- Portal primary + email-copy window (what Marissa described): we enable the portal, then set an outbound fan-out to your AP inbox for 90 days. No SFTP required.
- SFTP push: we can push e-invoice XML files nightly to an SFTP endpoint. We use the eInvoice_schema_v2.xml (attached) as our baseline. If you want this, send us a test SFTP path and a public key.
- Email-only: we can also only send PDFs to one or more emails, but this has higher manual reconciliation overhead.

Required info from Acme to proceed with portal+email-copy:
1) AP inbox to receive copies (ap-team@acme-corp.com confirmed)
2) PO number (GF-1724)
3) VAT registration or evidence files (uploaded to portal is preferred; email attachments OK temporarily)

I've attached our eInvoice_schema_v2.xml and a small sample payload (invoice_sample.pdf) for your AP team's tester. Sam, when you confirm the three items above I'll:
- Turn on portal enrollment for your tenant
- Configure outbound fan-out to ap-team@acme-corp.com for 90 days
- Send a one-time test invoice and a short checklist for your team to validate ingestion

Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.example.com
Attachment: eInvoice_schema_v2.xml

Thanks Marissa and Connor — that sounds good. Confirming:
- Acme will enroll in the portal as primary.
- Please enable an automatic PDF copy to ap-team@acme-corp.com for the first 90 days.
- PO GF-1724 is the purchase order for the engagement.
- AP contact is ap-team@acme-corp.com (shared inbox) and I'll be the escalation contact at samantha.lee@acme-corp.com.
- For VAT evidence: we'll upload documents to the portal when available, and will send any outstanding certificates as email attachments in the meantime.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to run the test file when you send it.

Best,
Samantha Lee

Acme Corp
